notes: AXIS MAPPING: Lenovo publishes closed-state Dimensions (WxDxH) = 299.1 x 203.9 x 15.95 mm; manufacturer WIDTH 299.1 -> closed.width, manufacturer DEPTH 203.9 -> closed.height, manufacturer HEIGHT/thickness 15.95 -> closed.depth. closed.width is therefore the LONG axis, opposite to the phone-vendor convention. dimensions_mm.open null - Lenovo publishes no opened dimension. mass_g from 'Starting at 1.34 kg' x 1000 = 1340 g; STARTING weight, varies by configuration. Gen 9 (13IMU9) is chassis-identical to Gen 8 (13IRU8): PSREF lists byte-identical dimensions, weight, panel and case material; the generational change is the CPU (Intel Core Ultra / Meteor Lake) and DisplayPort 2.1 + Always On ports. These numbers were nonetheless read from the Gen 9 PSREF document itself, not carried over from the Gen 8 entry. PSREF doc dated October 21 2025. TWO DISCRETE PANELS, roles primary + secondary, identical. active_area_mm derived from sourced diagonal + resolution assuming square pixels: 13.3 x 2880 / sqrt(2880^2+1800^2) x 25.4 = 286.5 mm wide, 179.0 mm high. hinge.axis 'long' read from the sound-bar hinge geometry, not a quoted axis statement. announced null: no lenovo.com or news.lenovo.com press release for the Gen 9 specifically could be retrieved; CES 2024 (January 2024) is reported only by secondary tech press (Laptop Mag, PCWorld, Notebookcheck), which SPEC forbids as a source, so the field is left null rather than filled from them. released null for the same reason ('April 2024' is secondary-only and not a full date). PORTS: 3x USB-C only, no headphone jack, no HDMI; position null (PSREF overview callouts are image labels). materials.cover_glass null - PSREF names no cover glass product.
